About.title: We supply the best dairy products
About.text: Milcow connects partner farms in Korea directly with business buyers. Buy anything from raw milk to cheese, butter and milk powder by the ton, and lock in stable volumes and prices with a monthly supply contract.
About.point1: Buy fresh milk from partner farms directly, by the ton
About.point2: Monthly supply contracts keep your price fixed
About.point3: Pick up or get delivery from 0–4 °C cold-chain warehouses
